import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""))

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with brand colors
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
brands = data['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(brands))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = data[data['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
               s=100, alpha=0.7, label=brand, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price with size by megapixels
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
scatter = ax2.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['price_usd'], 
                     s=data['megapixels']*10, alpha=0.6, c=data['model_year'], 
                     cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Weight vs Price (size=MP, color=Year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Year')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Brand distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
brand_counts = data['brand'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=colors[:len(brand_counts)], alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Camera Count by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Model year timeline
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(data['model_year'], data['price_usd'], s=100, alpha=0.7, color='steelblue')
for idx, row in data.iterrows():
    ax4.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['price_usd']), 
                fontsize=7, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Price Evolution Over Years', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 5. Sensor type distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax5.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax5.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Body type vs 4K video
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_4k = pd.crosstab(data['body_type'], data['has_video_4k'])
body_4k.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax6, color=['coral', 'lightblue'], alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type vs 4K Video Support', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend(['No 4K', '4K'], fontsize=8)
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Max ISO comparison
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.barh(data['brand'] + ' ' + data['model_year'].astype(str), data['max_iso'], 
         color=colors[:len(data)], alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Camera', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Maximum ISO Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Megapixels distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.hist(data['megapixels'], bins=5, color='skyblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Megapixels Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 9. Summary statistics table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = data[['megapixels', 'price_usd', 'weight_grams']].describe().round(2)
table_data = summary_stats.loc[['mean', 'std', 'min', 'max']].T
table = ax9.table(cellText=table_data.values, 
                 rowLabels=table_data.index,
                 colLabels=['Mean', 'Std', 'Min', 'Max'],
                 cellLoc='center', loc='center', 
                 colWidths=[0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(8)
table.scale(1, 1.5)
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

plt.suptitle('Camera Specifications Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
